svg.title: Historical forecast differences
svg.desc: Development-selected score configurations · fixed default XGBoost reference · lower difference favors score model Lines: 2.5%–97.5% stationary-bootstrap percentiles, 2,000 paired resamples per setting. Blocks count observed UTC match-days. Historical cohort reused; pointwise exploratory ranges, no significance claim. Run b72b4ac0a4df45e4 · frozen predictions, no refitting · Football-Data 2022/23–2024/25
